description: What Bitween calls on each kind of adapter, and what it passes. Bitween calls adapters by method name over the SW-Serverless protocol; the names below are exact and case-sensitive.

encoding.string: A string argument or result is the raw UTF-8 text, not a JSON string.
encoding.object: Any other argument or result is JSON, with property names exactly as its schema gives them.
encoding.none: A method with no argument receives an empty payload; one with no result returns an empty payload.

FileId.description: An id a receiver gave in ListFiles, passed back exactly as given.

errors: A call fails when the adapter raises an error; Bitween records the error's type and message on the exchange, and retry policies decide what happens next. A handler whose partner rejected the message does not fail: it returns the partner's answer with BadData true.

handler.description: Delivers a message and returns the partner's response.

mapper.description: Transforms a message into the shape the next step expects.

validator.description: Checks a message before it is accepted.

receiver.description: Fetches files from a source on a schedule.
receiver.session: One session per run. Calls come in this order: Initialize, ListFiles, then for each file GetFile and, once it is safely taken in, DeleteFile, and finally Finalize, which is also called after a failure.
